Suppressed with a rationale, seven, and the reason is the same for five of them:
THE LOOP IS OVER MODELS, NOT RECORDS. mixin_merge:277, ir_actions:218 and :252,
ir_model_data:494 and ir_actions_server:858 each query a different table per turn,
and a search cannot be unioned across tables. res_country:279 loops over search
TERMS, each its own fuzzy match with its own remaining limit. res_groups:494 is
the one deliberate case: 4a6768ae1f6 replaced len(all_user_ids) with search_count
on purpose, because the relational read materialises the whole implied-user
population per render, and fields.Count cannot take that back -- count_of on a
computed non-stored m2m resolves counts_in_database=False and falls straight back
to the len().
